about: English specs and build status of the decided healing batch (cbmagic_healing.tpa). Optional IWDification symbols are changed only when the installed game provides them.

parts.spec: Cure Light Wounds is 1d8 + 5 with casting time 4; optional IWD Cure Moderate Wounds is 2d8 + 4 with casting time one shorter; Cure Medium, Serious and Critical Wounds are respectively 2d8 + 7 at 4, 3d8 + 7 at 6, and 4d8 + 12 at 7. Unrelated abilities and effects stay intact; descriptions and actual scroll descriptions match.
Mass Cure keeps its effect exactly as it is and has casting time 4; its description and actual scroll descriptions match.

Cause Light, Moderate, Medium, Serious and Critical Wounds use the matching Cure roll (1d8 + 5, 2d8 + 4, 2d8 + 7, 3d8 + 7, 4d8 + 12) and their decided shorter casting times. Each heals undead with that same roll instead of damaging them, while keeping its normal direct or touch-charge delivery, save and unrelated effects for other targets; descriptions and actual scroll descriptions match.

Optional IWD Mass Cause Light Wounds keeps its native per-ability damage roll, casting time and save rule. It heals undead with the corresponding roll instead of damaging them; description and actual scroll descriptions match.
Harm keeps its existing effect on non-undead, has casting time 7, and heals undead completely as Heal does. Its description and actual scroll descriptions match.
